title: Do Not Recommend... Unless You Do Not Mind Did Sticking To Your Griddle
text:
Do Not Recommend... Unless You Do Not Mind Did Sticking To Your Griddle. After using several Teflon-coated griddles over many years, I was excited to give the ceramic model a try.

Was a failure for us. Everything seem to stick to the surface. We gave up using this griddle very quickly!

description: Wake your family to fluffy, golden brown pancakes made on the Hamilton Beach Durathon Ceramic Griddle. Hash browns, eggs, sausage? It can handle it all. With it's ceramic nonstick coating and 200 square inch cooking surface, you can make a whole meal with little fuss and easy cleanup. Made with Durathon ceramic, this griddle provides you with superior nonstick performance that is four times more durable than traditional nonstick coatings. You won't have to scrape your meal off the cooking surface because hotcakes and fried eggs flip with ease. The heat is adjustable for a greater range of cooking options and the handles remain cool to the touch. Griddles are commonly used at breakfast because they are perfect for pancakes, French toast and fried eggs, but they are flexible enough to be used all day. Try grilled cheese sandwiches for lunch and you'll be amazed at how evenly the cheese is melted and the bread browned. For dinner, make tender, juicy hamburgers and hotdogs.
